Water Ponding, outlets, erosion, staining and known stormwater connections. Frequently Asked Questions What affects the cost of a retaining wall? Height, length and wall system matter, but excavation, spoil removal, access, soil conditions, surcharge loads, drainage, engineering and approvals can change the total more than the facing material. Compare quotes on the same scope and check whether drainage, backfill, engineering, permits, disposal and GST are included. Should retaining-wall quotes be compared per metre or per square metre?
